data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (type venue, select suggestion, select event, sort/times, update search), but it merges event and date into one parameter, names a specific filter (wheelchair accessible) that the true run didn't use, and leaves out the final Book Now click, so it's somewhat vague for automation.
